enquiryActions.closeDescription: Records the outcome. A closed enquiry cannot be reopened here.
enquiryActions.lostHint: They went elsewhere, or it fell through

quoteDetail.expired: This quotation expired on {on}. The figures below are what was offered; a new version is needed to quote again.
quoteDetail.marginHint: Frozen when this was priced — a later rate change does not alter it
quoteDetail.validUntilHint: After this it expires by itself
quoteDetail.linesExplain: The priced lines as they were at quoting time.
quoteDetail.noLinesHint: The totals above were entered directly rather than built from charges.
quoteDetail.aboutExplain: Where it came from and who prepared it.
quoteDetail.historyExplain: A revision is a new version. The old one still exists, unchanged, because the customer may be holding it.

confirm.sent: The customer will be able to act on this price. The margin is already frozen and will not change.
confirm.accepted: Records that the customer accepted. A shipment can then be opened against it.
confirm.rejected: Closes this quotation. If they come back, quote a new version rather than reopening this one.

moveDescription.sent: Confirm the price is right before it goes out.
moveDescription.accepted: The customer has agreed this price.
moveDescription.rejected: The customer went elsewhere or declined.

invoiceDetail.overdueSince: Payment was due on {on} and has not been received in full.
invoiceDetail.balanceHint: Total less everything matched to it
invoiceDetail.linesExplain: The charges on this invoice. Issued invoices cannot be edited — a correction is a credit note.
invoiceDetail.linesExplainDraft: Add charges while this is a draft. It gets its number when you issue it.
invoiceDetail.noLinesHintDraft: Add the charges, then issue it.
invoiceDetail.descriptionHint: What the customer will read on the invoice
invoiceDetail.chargeHint: Groups the line on the printed invoice
invoiceDetail.taxableHint: Tax is added at this invoice's rate
invoiceDetail.addLineDescription: The totals are recalculated from every line.

confirm.approved: Marks the invoice as reviewed. It still has no number and can be edited.
confirm.issued: This allocates the next number in the branch's series and cannot be undone. An issued invoice can only be corrected with a credit note.
confirm.void: Cancels this invoice. The number stays used, so the series has no gap, and the document has no effect.
confirm.credited: Records that a credit note replaces this invoice.

moveDescription.void: It will no longer be payable.

partnerDetail.totalJobsHint: How long you have worked together

partnerDetail.contactsExplain: Who to call. Kept on the partner, not in somebody's phone.

settings.title: Settings

settings.referenceMoved: Ports, charge types and other reference data are operational and stayed in

support.bannerRead: Support has read access to your data
support.bannerWrite: Support has write access to your data

support.emptyTitle: No support access has ever been granted
support.emptyHint: When support needs to look at your data, you grant it here — for a fixed period, to named branches, against a ticket.

supportGrant.title: Grant support access
supportGrant.description: Opens this deployment to one named engineer, for a fixed period. It expires on its own and you can withdraw it at any time.

supportGrant.reasonPlaceholder: SUP-1042 — invoice total disputed on KWI-2026-01041
supportGrant.reasonHint: Recorded against every session opened under this grant.

supportGrant.escalateHint: Only needed for read and write. Type GRANT WRITE to confirm.
supportGrant.note: Every session opened under this grant is recorded, and the record cannot be edited or deleted by anyone — including us.

notFound.title: That page does not exist
notFound.description: The link may be out of date, or the record may have been closed. If you reached this from inside the system, the reference may belong to a branch you do not have access to.

errorPage.description: The problem has been recorded. Nothing you were working on has been lost — a page that fails does not write anything.
